question: A molecule with the chemical formula C₂H₆ is a/an ______ molecule.
solution:
The correct answer is __**ethane**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Ethane is a simple hydrocarbon with the chemical formula C₂H₆.
 
• It is a colorless, odorless gas at standard temperature and pressure.
 
• Ethane is the second simplest alkane, following methane, in the alkane series.
 
• It is primarily used as a petrochemical feedstock in the production of ethylene.
 
• Ethane is also present in natural gas and is separated during natural gas processing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Alkanes:**

 
 
• Alkanes are saturated hydrocarbons, meaning they consist entirely of single bonds between carbon atoms.
 
• They follow the general formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₂.
 
• Alkanes are also known as paraffins and are found in natural gas and petroleum.
 
 
 
• **Ethylene:**
 
 
• Ethylene, with the chemical formula C₂H₄, is an important industrial organic chemical.
 
• It is produced from ethane through a process called steam cracking.
 
• Ethylene is used to make polyethylene, a common plastic.
 
 
 
• **Natural Gas Processing:**
 
 
• Natural gas processing involves separating various hydrocarbons and fluids from pure natural gas.
 
• Components like methane, ethane, propane, butanes, and pentanes are separated during this process.
 
 
 
• **Petrochemical Feedstock:**
 
 
• Petrochemical feedstocks are raw materials used in the production of chemicals derived from petroleum.
 
• Ethane is one of the primary feedstocks used to produce ethylene and other chemicals.
